name: print-social-shape-ideas-virtually-poster-black-holographic-blobs
title: 'Shape Ideas Virtually' poster in black with holographic blob shapes and a thin vertical rule
whatItIs: A black A4 poster on an indigo backdrop with a bold white three-line headline 'Shape Ideas Virtually', a thin vertical rule with a downward arrow, small sparkle stars, and two holographic gradient blob shapes glowing pink-blue-purple in opposite corners.
whatItMeans: Sleek and futuristic; two small holographic blobs are enough accent to make a mostly typographic poster feel high-tech.
techniques: Use just two small holographic accents to punctuate a minimal layout.
Add a thin vertical rule with an arrow as a subtle directional device.
Keep the headline in plain bold sans for contrast against the shiny accents.

vocabulary.definition: A glossy shape with a shifting rainbow gradient.
A thin line with an arrow guiding the eye downward.
